amimi.configuration.enableOpenGuidePageB: Whether users can open a multiblock's related GuideME page, if available. Note that users don't need to have the corresponding book in their inventory and can open other guide pages.
amimi.configuration.uniqueHatchColors.to: Whether when a hatch position only has one type allowed (i.e. only fluid I/O), an unique color should be used to highlight it. Otherwise, uses the default green.
